welcome.title: Welcome to Lumix
welcome.description: Select a server from the sidebar or create a new one

server.name: Server Name
server.consoleHint: Logs will appear here after the server starts
server.clearConsoleConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear all logs? This action cannot be undone.
server.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this server?
server.deleteWarning: This action cannot be undone. All server data will be permanently deleted.
server.settingsDescription: Manage launch settings and server.properties in one place. Most changes apply after the server is stopped.
server.settingsLocked: Settings cannot be changed while the server is running. Stop the server first.
server.readyDescription: Server files are ready. You can start the server now or adjust settings first.
server.downloadingDescription: The server core is still being prepared. It can start after the download finishes.
server.runtimeRunningDescription: The server is running and the console will show live output. Settings are temporarily locked.
server.runtimeTransitionDescription: The server is changing state. Wait for the current action to finish.
server.runtimeStoppedDescription: The server is stopped. You can edit settings, open the folder, or start it.
server.settingsPreviewDescription: Common server.properties options now live on a dedicated page, covering gameplay, world generation, network, and performance.

gamemode.label: Default Game Mode
gamemode.description: Game mode used when new players join.

difficulty.label: Difficulty
difficulty.description: Controls hostile mobs, damage, hunger, and overall world difficulty.

max-players.label: Max Players
max-players.description: Maximum number of players allowed online at the same time.

pvp.label: Allow PvP
pvp.description: When enabled, players can damage each other.

hardcore.label: Hardcore Mode
hardcore.description: Dead players enter spectator mode, suited for high-risk worlds.

force-gamemode.label: Force Game Mode
force-gamemode.description: Players are reset to the default game mode whenever they join.

allow-flight.label: Allow Flight
allow-flight.description: Allows flying, commonly needed for modded or creative servers.

white-list.label: Enable Whitelist
white-list.description: Only players on the whitelist can join.

enforce-whitelist.label: Enforce Whitelist
enforce-whitelist.description: Kicks players who are no longer allowed after whitelist changes.

online-mode.label: Online Mode
online-mode.description: Verifies player identity through Mojang/Microsoft authentication.

server-port.label: Server Port
server-port.description: TCP port players use to connect.

server-ip.label: Bind IP
server-ip.description: Usually left blank so the server listens on all available interfaces.

enable-status.label: Public Status
enable-status.description: Allows clients to show status and MOTD in the server list.

enable-query.label: Enable Query
enable-query.description: Exposes GameSpy4 query data for external status tools.

query.port.label: Query Port
query.port.description: UDP port used by the query protocol.

enable-rcon.label: Enable RCON
enable-rcon.description: Allows remote administration tools to send commands through RCON.

rcon.port.label: RCON Port
rcon.port.description: Port used by RCON remote administration.

rcon.password.label: RCON Password
rcon.password.description: Remote administration password. Set this before enabling RCON.

motd.label: MOTD
motd.description: Welcome message shown in the Minecraft server list.

level-name.label: World Folder
level-name.description: World folder the server loads or creates.

level-seed.label: World Seed
level-seed.description: Seed used for new world generation; existing worlds usually do not change.

level-type.label: World Type
level-type.description: World generation type, such as minecraft:normal or flat.

generate-structures.label: Generate Structures
generate-structures.description: Controls whether villages, strongholds, and other structures generate.

allow-nether.label: Allow Nether
allow-nether.description: Allows players to enter the Nether dimension.

spawn-animals.label: Spawn Animals
spawn-animals.description: Controls natural spawning for friendly animals.

spawn-monsters.label: Spawn Monsters
spawn-monsters.description: Controls natural spawning for hostile mobs.

spawn-npcs.label: Spawn NPCs
spawn-npcs.description: Controls spawning for villagers and other NPCs.

spawn-protection.label: Spawn Protection
spawn-protection.description: Protected block radius around the world spawn.

view-distance.label: View Distance
view-distance.description: Chunk distance sent to players. Higher values increase server load.

simulation-distance.label: Simulation Distance
simulation-distance.description: Chunk distance where entities and block ticks are simulated.

enable-command-block.label: Command Blocks
enable-command-block.description: Allows command blocks to execute commands.

op-permission-level.label: OP Permission Level
op-permission-level.description: Permission level for operators, from 1 to 4.

function-permission-level.label: Function Permission Level
function-permission-level.description: Permission level used when datapack functions execute commands.

player-idle-timeout.label: Idle Timeout
player-idle-timeout.description: Minutes before idle players are kicked. 0 disables this.

max-tick-time.label: Max Tick Time
max-tick-time.description: Triggers the watchdog when a tick exceeds this many milliseconds. -1 disables it.

network-compression-threshold.label: Compression Threshold
network-compression-threshold.description: Packets above this byte size are compressed. -1 disables compression.

resource-pack.label: Resource Pack URL
resource-pack.description: URL for the resource pack offered when players join.

require-resource-pack.label: Require Resource Pack
require-resource-pack.description: Players must accept the resource pack before joining.

resource-pack-sha1.label: Resource Pack SHA-1
resource-pack-sha1.description: Checksum used to verify the downloaded resource pack.

toast.noCompatibleJava: No compatible Java version found for this Minecraft version

toast.javaCannotRemove: System-detected Java cannot be manually removed
